items.body: Australian dark electro duo Avarice In Audio released “Welcome To Weimar America” on 11 September 2026 through Alfa Matrix. The 12-track digital album is the seventh full-length from Gerry Hawkins and Lawrie B (Studio-X) and pushes the duo’s sound toward industrial rock, elektro-metal and guitar-driven material. The tracklist runs “Welcome Home”, “Let Them Eat Violence”, “I Know You”, “Time To Swing”, “Bareback In Babylon”, “The End Is Nigh”, “Let The Boreal Burn (v.2026)” featuring Static Logic, “Prophet & Loss”, “Our Trade Is War”, “The Devil Gets His Due”, “Baroque Ruins” and an Avarice In Audio remix of “Bareback In Babylon”. Artwork is by Kallisti Design. Welcome To Weimar America by Avarice In Audio “Let The Boreal Burn (v.2026)” reworks a track with longtime collaborator Static Logic, and the closing track remixes “Bareback In Babylon” in the band’s own hands. Alfa Matrix describes the album as the duo’s “most extreme, abrasive and deliberately uncomfortable” record to date, moving away from the darker synth-pop, harsh elektro and EBM of their earlier catalogue. Avarice In Audio’s history on Alfa Matrix Avarice In Audio previously released “Tear Heaven In Half” on Alfa Matrix in October 2024, a 17-track album that folded in Drum ‘n’ Bass, techno and hard-rock elements and featured Static Logic, Canadian artist Virtual Terrorist and Studio-X. Before that came the “Drowning One” EP (September 2024) and the single “Wicked Die Alone” (February 2024). “Welcome To Weimar America” is the duo’s first full album since “Tear Heaven In Half”. About Avarice In Audio Avarice In Audio is an Australian dark electro project built around Gerry Hawkins and Lawrie B, who also records as Studio-X. The band’s fourth album, “From The Rib Of Adam”, preceded a reduction to the current two-person line-up. As a duo, Avarice In Audio released the “The Language Of Violence” EP in June 2022, featuring a remix by aggrotech act Viscera Drip and a version by Studio-X, ahead of the fifth album “Our Idols Are Filth” in October 2022, which included collaborations with iVardensphere and the Italian project T-Error Machinez. The band returned with the “I Pray” EP in February 2021 featuring Assemblage 23’s Tom Shear, and later issued the “War Tanz” EP with an accompanying video in April 2023. “Tear Heaven In Half” followed in October 2024, described by Gerry Hawkins in a Side-Line interview as splitting into a heavier first half and a softer, futurepop-leaning second half. “Welcome To Weimar America” is the band’s seventh studio album and continues the collaboration with Static Logic that ran through “Tear Heaven In Half”.
items._genre: dark electro / industrial rock / EBM / elektro-metal
items._cn_summary: 澳洲双人组合Avarice In Audio发行第七张全长专辑《Welcome To Weimar America》，由Alfa Matrix厂牌于2026年9月推出，共12首曲目。专辑延续二人一贯的暗电子与工业根基，但明显向工业摇滚、电金属和吉他驱动的方向倾斜，厂牌将其描述为迄今为止最为极端、粗粝且刻意制造不适感的作品。合作方面，老搭档Static Logic参与了《Let The Boreal Burn (v.2026)》的重新演绎，末曲则由乐队自行混音《Bareback In Babylon》。专辑延续此前《Tear Heaven In Half》的多元风格路径，融合了Drum'n'Bass、Techno与硬摇滚等元素。美术由Kallisti Design担纲，整体延续了乐队对政治与社会议题的尖锐表达。

items.body: No one could heal your sensible heart Angels above watching over you I will be here just to see you heal With your own will Tokyo’s Sex Virgin Killer have spent their existence treating genre boundaries with roughly the same respect a speeding motorcycle gives a painted line in the road. Punk, Visual-Kei, metal, darkwave: all of it has gone into the engine at one point or another, sometimes colliding violently, sometimes locking together with the ridiculous precision of machinery that probably should have exploded three exits ago. On Lissajous (Shinobu Narita Remix), that long history suddenly opens into something almost impossibly sweet. Narita, a frequent collaborator whose résumé reaches back to Japanese new wave and techno-pop group Urban Dance and forward through production work with Boris, understands exactly where the song’s bloodstream runs. He takes the original Lissajous and draws its electronic architecture into sharper relief, bringing the melody forward until the track feels enormous without becoming bloated. Synth lines rise with the clean romantic rush of Erasure, while the clipped electronic contours recall early Depeche Mode before stadium dimensions entered the equation. There is something wonderfully reckless about placing lyrics this bruised inside music this euphoric. The song concerns survival after emotional damage, where scars remain legible even after the body has learned to move again. Broken wings grow back. The moon becomes a guide across distance. Two people separated by whatever catastrophe preceded the song may cross paths again, and connection becomes less a promise than an act of faith repeated until somebody believes it. Sex Virgin Killer understand that recovery can carry its own strange exhilaration; once you have spent enough time staring into the abyss, simply realizing you can still move feels almost indecently luxurious. Narita exploits that tension beautifully: his electronics give the chorus a soaring physical quality, and the sweetness never turns syrupy because the words beneath it carry too much accumulated damage. There is real pop intelligence at work here, the kind that knows heartbreak becomes more devastating when the synthesizer seems convinced heaven remains within reach. Narita has taken a beautiful song about learning to fly again and given it considerably more sky. Coming after Sex Virgin Killer’s sold-out Finnish tour and their latest album, ANGEL, the remix also feels like another marker in a career built around motion. Twenty years into their evolution, they remain willing to push their music toward different rooms without abandoning the personality that got them there. The KiTalbum edition wisely includes both original versions of Lissajous from the international and Japanese editions of ANGEL, allowing the remix to sit beside its earlier forms. The international album appeared through Germany’s Young & Cold Records on vinyl and digipak CD, while the Japanese edition arrived through the band’s own lilii sound loom on cassette and CD. Listen to Lissajous (Shinobu Narita Remix) below and order the single here. items._cn_summary: 东京乐队Sex Virgin Killer的暗黑浪潮风格在二十余年发展中融合了朋克、视觉系、金属等多种元素，几乎无视类型边界。此次发行的单曲为Shinobu Narita对原曲Lissajous的混音版本，Narita曾与日本新浪波及合成器流行团体Urban Dance合作，并为Boris担任制作人。混音版将原作的电子架构勾勒得更为锐利，使旋律向前推进，合成器线条呈现出Erasure式的干净浪漫感，同时让人联想到早期Depeche Mode尚未进入体育场规模的电子轮廓。歌词围绕情感创伤后的生存展开，破碎的翅膀重新生长，月亮成为穿越距离的指引，两人在某场灾难后再度交汇，连接变为不断重复的信仰行为。混音将副歌推向辽阔的物理质感，甜美却不流于甜腻，词句中积累的伤痕维持了张力。KiTalbum版本同时收录国际版与日本版ANGEL专辑中的Lissajous原作，发行渠道包括德国Young & Cold Records及日本厂牌。

items.body: ACTORS Our Love Will Live Forever Artoffact Records There’s been a real sense of inevitability to the rise of Vancouver post-punk quartet ACTORS since the release of 2018’s debut LP It Will Come to You. Vocalist, guitarist, producer and bandleader Jason Corbett’s vision for melodic post-punk as an amalgamation of hooks, atmosphere and sharp production has always been an easy sell (as evidenced by their incredibly loyal international fanbase), but in a world where the best execution is no guarantee of success, ACTORS have never seemed like they were going anywhere but up. New album Our Love Will Last Forever feels no different in that regard, its studied mix of danceable rhythms and memorable choruses adding to their momentum. On its surface, the appeal of the record is extremely obvious: the songs are good. Really good. There’s a warmth and familiarity to cuts like “Youth” that comes through in Corbett’s vocals, the incredibly tight rhythm section of drummer Adam Fink and bassist Kendall Wooding, and the backing vocals and keys of Shannon Hemmett. It all feels natural, easy, fun to move to. That sensibility ports handily into the restrained but ever building sound of “Object of Desire”, whose twinned vocals are saturated and compressed together, adding to the effect when each voice breaks out on its own during the underplayed, yet somehow still massive chorus. The quietly stunning “In Real Life” stands as a testament to ACTORS’ songcraft, its relative simplicity belying how deeply it sinks its claws in, brimming with a melancholia so thick it’s intoxicating. It’s almost certainly the best song ACTORS have ever released, and not for any reason beyond how relatable its plaintive hope comes across. Beyond the actual songwriting and performances, Our Love Will Live Forever is a document of Corbett’s skill as a producer, and his understanding of what makes his own songs tick. The mix is thick and lively, and while there’s always have plenty going on, the LP never feel overly busy. Listen to how CTRL keeps the bass way up in front, backing it with synths and a disco drumbeat that provides room for vocal ad libs, quick guitar licks, bursts of keys, and swells of delay and reverb that serve the cut instead of detracting from it. That refined approach is a big key to making it work; the funky cowbell and claps that put the Devo-esque new wave boogie of “Stimulation” over the top could have been tacky, but the track’s arrangement and mix keep them tasteful. It really is a tremendous sounding record from a production standpoint both clever when suitable (listen to how the wink and a smile of “Bad Boys (Don’t Go to Heaven)” jumps from dry and zoomed in to lush and widescreen in the blink of an eye), but always with the best interests of the song in mind; when it’s time to let things breathe, as on “Dead Inside”, the song is presented simply, as it might sound coming off a stage rather than from a meticulous multi-tracked recording. Of all of the record’s merits, Our Love Will Live Forever‘s greatest strength lies in taking ACTORS already well-established sound to new levels. The bass rumbles harder, the grooves are tighter, the melodies more instantaneous. For the relatively simple remit of zeroing in on what works and doing more of it, it ends up being quite an achievement, and what’s more, one that somehow sounds effortless. Recommended. Buy it. Our Love Will Live Forever by ACTORS The post ACTORS, “Our Love Will Last Forever” appeared first on I Die: You Die.
items._genre: post-punk / darkwave / new wave / synth-pop
items._cn_summary: 温哥华后朋克乐队ACTORS的第三张专辑延续了2018年首作以来的上升势头，由主创Jason Corbett主导制作。整张唱片以旋律性后朋克为核心，融合新舞曲律动与新浪潮元素，歌曲结构清晰、节奏紧凑，强调hook与和声的可听性。制作层面尤为突出：混音厚实而不杂乱，层次分明，贝斯始终前置，合成器、迪斯科鼓点与人声即兴相互留白。双人主唱在饱和压缩下交织，合唱段落于克制中爆发出宽阔的听感。多首作品在干声与湿润效果间快速切换，展示了成熟的录音棚思维。乐队扎根独立厂牌Artoffact Records，面向忠实的国际暗潮/后朋克社群，作品在类型框架内展现出高水准的工艺与明确的个人审美，但并未突破后朋克/暗潮的传统范式。

items.album: 【ARBAN WEEKLY／今週のニュースまとめ】コルトレーン生誕100年、サリヴァン・フォートナー、ステフォン・ハリスの新作など
items.excerpt: コルトレーン生誕100年—東洋への視線は誰に受け継がれたか 2026年9月1日、ジョン・コルトレーンの生誕100周年を記念する特集をNPRが組んだ。コルトレーンは1926年9月23日生まれで、今回の特集はその節目を前にした報道である。60年代半ば、コルトレーンは東洋音楽やスピリチュアルな思想への接近を深めていったとされる。単なる異文化への憧れではなく、サックスという楽器そのものを通じて瞑想的な音響空間を作ろうとした試みだったと言われている。 この視線は、彼の死後も途切れなかった。妻であり音楽家のアリス・コルトレーンは、インドの聖典やラーガの構造を自身の作品に取り込み、スピリチュアルジャズという系譜を独自に開拓した人物として知られる。同時代を並走したファラオ・サンダースも、アフリカと東洋の要素を重ねた音響を追求し続けた。近年ではカマシ・ワシントンが、大作を通じてこの系譜を現代のジャズ・オーケストレーションとして甦らせている。 生誕100年という数字そのものより、コルトレーンが開いた「サックスの向こう側」への扉が、半世紀以上経ってなお閉じていないことのほうが、記念すべき事実なのかもしれない
items.body: コルトレーン生誕100年—東洋への視線は誰に受け継がれたか 2026年9月1日、ジョン・コルトレーンの生誕100周年を記念する特集をNPRが組んだ。コルトレーンは1926年9月23日生まれで、今回の特集はその節目を前にした報道である。60年代半ば、コルトレーンは東洋音楽やスピリチュアルな思想への接近を深めていったとされる。単なる異文化への憧れではなく、サックスという楽器そのものを通じて瞑想的な音響空間を作ろうとした試みだったと言われている。 この視線は、彼の死後も途切れなかった。妻であり音楽家のアリス・コルトレーンは、インドの聖典やラーガの構造を自身の作品に取り込み、スピリチュアルジャズという系譜を独自に開拓した人物として知られる。同時代を並走したファラオ・サンダースも、アフリカと東洋の要素を重ねた音響を追求し続けた。近年ではカマシ・ワシントンが、大作を通じてこの系譜を現代のジャズ・オーケストレーションとして甦らせている。 生誕100年という数字そのものより、コルトレーンが開いた「サックスの向こう側」への扉が、半世紀以上経ってなお閉じていないことのほうが、記念すべき事実なのかもしれない。 出典：https://www.npr.org/2026/09/01/nx-s1-5951499/celebrating-100-years-of-jazz-great-john-coltrane ロン・カーター×ヨタム・シルバースタイン、ピアノレス・デュオの系譜 ジャズ専門誌『Jazz Journal』が8-9月の新譜ガイドを発表した。中でも注目したいのが、ベーシスト、ロン・カーターとギタリスト、ヨタム・シルバースタインによるデュエット作である。これはジム・ホールへのトリビュートとして企画されたという。   ロン・カーターとジム・ホールは、かつてベースとギターだけで対話する録音を残している。伴奏を必要としないピアノレス・デュオという形式は、当時としては実験的な試みだった。今回のシルバースタインとの再演は、その系譜を半世紀後の若い世代の手に橋渡しする作業とも言える。 なお同時期には、Sidiki Camaraの野心作、Tristan Cappelの追悼盤、15年ぶりとなるDeirdre Cartwrightの新作も発表されている。それぞれの詳細は今後の紹介に譲りたい。 出典：https://jazzjournal.co.uk/2026/08/30/new-releases-august-september-2026-c-d サリヴァン・フォートナー、ニューオーリンズの記憶を刻む ニューオーリンズ出身のピアニスト、サリヴァン・フォートナーが新作『Leave That In There』を発表した。ベーシストのタイロン・アレン2世、ドラマーのカイボン・ゴードンとの常編成トリオによる初のスタジオ録音である。 アルバム名は、ハリケーン・カトリーナを記録したドキュメンタリー映画『When the Levees Broke』（スパイク・リー監督、2006年）の台詞から取られたという。収録される12曲のオリジナルと再演には、ルイジアナ南部の風景や家族の記憶、黒人ディアスポラの伝統が織り込まれているとのことだ。 堤防が決壊し、街が水に沈んだあの記憶を、20年近くを経て一枚の音楽作品として刻み直す——グラミー受賞歴のあるピアニストによる、極めて個人的でありながら土地の歴史そのものでもある企画である。 出典：https://www.radiofrance.fr/francemusique/podcasts/au-coeur-du-jazz/sullivan-fortner-trio-apres-le-deluge-espoir-et-resilience-2428000 rd ウェンデル・ハリソンが語る、ファラオ・サンダースとサン・ラーの記憶 デトロイトのジャズ・アヴァンギャルドシーンを長く支えてきたウェンデル・ハリソンが、ele-kingのインタビューでファラオ・サンダースとサン・ラーとの出会いを振り返っている。デトロイトは、モータウンのサウンドで語られることが多い都市だが、同時にジャズの実験精神が根を張った土地でもあった。ハリソン自身、クラリネット奏者・サックス奏者としてこの街のシーン形成に長く携わってきた当事者であり、その証言には固有の重みがある。 インタビューでハリソンは、サンダースの音の探求とサン・ラーの宇宙的な音楽哲学、二人の巨人がそれぞれ異なる方向からスピリチュアル・ジャズの地平を切り開いていった様子を語る。一人の証人が二つの潮流を同時に見ていたという事実は、ジャズ史を線ではなく面として捉え直す手がかりになる。デトロイトという土地が、ニューヨークとは異なる形でアヴァンギャルドの拠点になり得たことも、この証言を通じて浮かび上がってくる。 出典：https://www.ele-king.net/interviews/012378 Stefon Harris & Blackout、20年の歩みと友への追悼 ヴィブラフォン奏者、ステフォン・ハリスが率いるBlackoutが、結成20周年を記念したアルバム『Legacy Dances』をMotémaからリリースした。本作は単なる周年企画ではなく、バンドの創設メンバーだったケイシー・ベンジャミンへの追悼という側面を色濃く持つ。 Blackoutは電子的な音響処理とアコースティックな演奏を融合させ、ジャズの語法を拡張してきたバンドである。本作ではルイ・アームストロング、ウィリー・ザ・ライオン・スミス、そして詩人アミリ・バラカへのオマージュも織り込まれ、ジャズを「共感の行動」として捉え直す哲学的な仕上がりになっているという。20年という時間の蓄積と、そこに刻まれた喪失が、一枚のアルバムのなかで響き合っている。 出典： https://www.radiofrance.fr/francemusique/podcasts/au-coeur-du-jazz/stefon-harris-blackout-feat-casey-benjamin-hommage-et-compagnonage-7477111 投稿 【ARBAN WEEKLY／今週のニュースまとめ】コルトレーン生誕100年、サリヴァン・フォートナー、ステフォン・ハリスの新作など は ARBAN に最初に表示されました。

items._cn_summary: 本文为多篇爵士新讯汇总，涵盖科尔曼诞辰百年回顾、隆·卡特与吉他手的无钢琴二重奏、萨利文·福特纳关于卡特里娜飓风记忆的钢琴三重奏新作、韦德尔·哈里森回忆法老·桑德斯与桑·拉尔的访谈，以及斯蒂芬·哈里斯Blackout乐队成立20周年纪念专辑。多位音乐人从东方哲学、拉格结构、宇宙观等角度拓展爵士的声学边界，作品融汇即兴、灵性与现代管弦化手法。同时涉及迪特律特作为先锋爵士重镇的历史脉络，以及新奥尔良地域传统的钢琴表达。整体聚焦于爵士传统在当代的多元延伸与精神性探索。

items.excerpt: アフロ～レゲエ～ヒップホップを縦横無尽にジャズるUK 5人組エズラ・コレクティヴの2年振り4th。ジャズ・アーティストとして史上初のマーキュリー・プライズを受賞し、ブリット・アワードも獲得した彼らの2026年作。前述の受賞による歴史的な数年間と各々で様々な共演を経て描かれる深いリズムに満ちた傑作。結成時からのコミュニティ、スピリチュアリティ、集団のエネルギーを根幹に枝葉が厚みを増し果実となった名演。国やジャンルの境界を押し広げ続けるバンドの姿を見事に捉え刻みこまれた2026年の重要作。ゲスト陣にも目移りするが、隅々まで物語あるアンサンブルが大輪となり雄弁に語る。ええやんええやん。

items._genre: jazz fusion / afrobeat / reggae / hip-hop / world jazz
items._cn_summary: 这是英国五人组Ezra Collective时隔两年推出的第四张专辑，以Afro、Reggae、Hip-Hop与爵士的跨界融合为核心。乐评指出，乐队在获得Mercury Prize与Brit Award之后，经历了多位艺术家的合作历程，将成立以来的社区精神与集体能量凝聚为更具厚度的作品。专辑延续了乐队跨越国界与流派界限的探索，从社区文化与精神性出发构建层层分支的节奏结构。客座阵容虽然亮眼，但专辑的核心仍在于整体叙事——每一处配器都承载意义，乐队成员之间的互动构成一部完整的作品，将群体的即兴张力转化为成熟而饱满的表达。

items.body: "There is no such thing as a stranger�s children." - old Ukrainian saying I�ve long been affected, indeed somewhat obsessed, by what�s happening in Ukraine, partly because of one of my favorite bands, DakhaBrakha. I went to Kyiv to see them at the time of the Maidan protests, just after the shooting by snipers of over a hundred protesters. I intentionally didn�t read this album�s booklet notes before listening, so that I could react to it without sympathetic pre-judgement, just as music. It�s strong musically and vocally by any standards, Ukrainian or otherwise. When I did then turn to the notes that translate and explain the songs, I had that rare experience, for me, of becoming moist-eyed. The songs are a mix of traditional and original. They are focused on the abduction by Russia of about 20,000 Ukrainian children who have been taken from their parents in Russian-occupied eastern Ukraine and sent to Russia, in an attempt to turn them into haters of their native land and people. It�s a heinous war crime. Marichka is a Ukrainian-Canadian singer who moves between Canada and her homeland. For this album she�s gathered two groups of musicians, one in each country. Both ensembles contribute vocals and instrumentation, mostly bowed strings, plus some bandura and piano. The group in Ukraine includes Lisa from the destroyed and invaded city of Mariupol, playing a solo on double ocarina; at 16 she was one of the stolen children but managed to return to Ukraine. Daughters of Donbas � co-led by Marichka and singer/bandurist Alina Kuzma, who shares the lead vocal role � is an all-female ensemble in Canada that tours performing these songs. �Foreign Land� is a reworking of a traditional song about the young girls who were sent away to work in foreign households - Marichka�s grandmother was one of these - that can also be taken to refer to the plight of today�s stolen children. The translation goes: A mother packed up her daughter To leave for a strange land To a strange land with strange people Oh, who will pity you, my daughter? Those who will beat me will pity me I'll never again live with you, my mother When, my daughter, should I expect you to come home? When the grass in the garden grows, my mother The grass grew and grew and began to dry The mother was waiting for her daughter to return, and began to cry Did you hear, my mother, how I came to you? How I flew as a bird above your window? How I cooed like a dove? If, my daughter, I could hear you I would open all the doors and windows To let you fly in Songs of Stolen Children by Daughters of Donbas, Alina Kuzma, Zo� Santo As befits the song, Marichka�s vocal here is gentle. But in the second track, �Rusalka,� with Alina Kuzma taking the lead vocals, things turn harsh and fierce. A rusalka is a mythical creature, a nature spirit of fields, forest and rivers, that features in traditional ritual songs. The melody of this one is by Zo� Santo and Kuzma, with lyrics drawing on tradition and the composition of Santo and 19thC Ukrainian poet and folklorist Taras Shevchenko. An ominous double-bass drone, chunking strings, a slithering vocal that moves into sections of white-voice fast recitative and expands into a soaring wild cry. The lyrics are very dark, perhaps evoking the hell of the front line: Home a hell of old growth stumps Marsh a mud of memories Don�t get bogged down in these parts Your kind won�t last a day in here While witches still fly, while roosters have yet to crow, Come here, something arises, �neath the oak something walks. A rusalka sat on a white birch, rusalky asked girls for shirts. Long fingers and nails so sharp Tongue forked round serrated teeth Moss grows down beneath her parts Weeds braided from ear to ear While witches still fly, while roosters have yet to crow, Come here, something arises, �neath the oak something walks. �Girls, my friends, give me your shirts. Though I�m thin, give me a thin one.� Here live us the backless ones Many voices of dead sons You are right to quake in fear Send your sinful children here �Who Am I� is a plea of separation and disorientation, the pain and confusion of an abducted child, contrasting �the human in me� and �the creature in me,� like an internalized riddle-song, with the refrain, in English: Who am I for you? Who am I for me? Do you know me? Really know me? �Enchantress,� passionately sung by Kuzma to her own bandura accompaniment, a girl�s lament of the loss of her brave love taken from her by the enchantress, who is an allegory of war, is based on a traditional song and uses that style of melody and lyrics, �Riddle,� sung by Marichka, reworks a traditional riddle song to be the riddles told by the grandfather of a child, 12-year-old Kira from Mariupol, who experienced the death of her father and her abduction to Russia. Her grandfather tracked her down, and brought her back, traumatized, and asked her riddles - as the notes say �to jog her memory, and remind her who she was, where her home was, and of her family�s love for her.� Songs of Stolen Children by Daughters of Donbas, Marichka �4.5.0� is a military expression for �all�s well� or �all is quiet.� The song is a message, as from a mother, to a stolen child. Marichka�s voice is cherishing: Remember this: I am with you, I am here Don't give up, I'm with you. Don't give up, I'm with you Your hope is my weapon Don't be sad, I'm with you 4.5.0. will be again �breaking into a tearing howl: And when the world's axis breaks When the sky folds like a parchment Out of nowhere her words will come� �and back to fragile reassurance �It's all right, I'm here, I'm here� "Lullaby," based on a traditional lullaby, sung by Alina Kuzma to accompaniment by her bandura and Zo� Santo's viola, starts in gentle lullaby style, but moves to a lament; it's for the stolen children and those who, as the notes put it, 'have been stolen for ever.' Songs of Stolen Children by Daughters of Donbas, Marichka �Remember, I Believe in You� is a powerful piece of harmonizing vocals and slithering strings. Here�s the story it�s based on: Yevhen lived in Mariupol with his three young children. During the siege they lived in a basement bomb shelter for months. One day, Russian soldiers entered their bomb shelter. Yevhen was taken to a filtration camp and separated from his children who were all taken to a hospital and then to Russian summer �camp�. In the filtration camp Yevhen was brutally tortured and forced to sleep standing on one leg. He tried to fall asleep, whispering prayers for his children: �Everything will be fine, I believe in you.� After his release he walked 30 kilometers to the place where his children had been taken but it was too late. They had already been sent to Moscow. Yevhen learned of this after receiving a text from one of his children who had found an unattended device. He traveled thousands of kilometers, crossed the borders of three countries, endured checks, interrogations and danger to reach Moscow and take his children home. All those days he tirelessly repeated to himself, �I believe in myself, I believe in my kids. Everything will be good.� �Another Heaven,� sung by Marichka with the ensemble in Ukraine, is inspired by another heart-rending story: Ilya was 9 years old when his mother was killed by a rocket strike right in front of him. He was taken to a hospital in occupied Donetsk, where 15 pieces of shrapnel were removed from his body without anesthesia. After he appeared in a report on Russian television, Ilya�s grandmother learned his location. She managed to bring her grandson to Kyiv, where he lives now, experiencing missile attacks every night. At age 11, he says that it is up to everyone to fight enemies, to protect other cities, and to build another heaven, where your home will not be destroyed. In 2014, during the Kyiv Maidan protests, Marichka wrote and performed �Red Boots Tango,� using a melody she�d put to a poem by Taras Shevchenko. For this album she sings it again in Ukraine, with the ensemble there adding swirling, classic tango-style strings. Songs of Stolen Children by Daughters of Donbas, BanduraGirl The final track on the album is a solo, recorded in Kyiv, by Anastasiya Voytyuk, accompanying herself on the older, simpler form of bandura that was used by kobzars to accompany epic poetry, and also on the nowadays more well-known big, heavy form developed from it in Soviet times that was made mainly in the piano factory at Chernihiv. Her song, �Soon I Will Be Back,� is based on a poem by novelist, journalist and war crime researcher Victoria Amelia, who was killed in 2023, in the city of Kramatorsk in Donbas, by a Russian rocket. Find the artist online. Further reading: Otava Yo - Do You Love (Review) Sofia Rei - Umbral (Review)

items.body:
A debut, digital-only EP from a Danish trio, led by one of the Nordic folk scene�s outstanding and experienced vocalists, Mia Guldhammer. Five tracks, with the musicians bringing their own perspectives to mostly traditional music. There�s a lovely ancient, creaky mood throughout.
The opener, �Svennedal,� with its rough, cantering rhythm, offers a perfect shop window for Guldhammer�s impressive, persuasive voice, while jaw harp and bagpipes bring an insistent propulsion to �Nordg�rd,� the only original here, by band member Morten Musicus.
Cimbalom adds a delicate backdrop to the traditional �Agnete Of Bjergmanden,� with Guldhammer�s soft jaw harp offering extra textures to the other instruments, as it brings a springy opening to the final cut, �Orms�,� mingling with flute and strings to create something quite thrilling and off kilter on this instrumental.
Five tracks, and an introduction to a band that already seems very mature and accomplished. A strong beginning � what will GuldGanger do with an entire album?

items._cn_summary: 这是丹麦三人组合GuldGanger的首张数字EP，由北欧民谣圈资深主唱Mia Guldhammer领衔。五首作品以传统曲目为主，成员各自带来不同的演奏视角，笼罩着一种古老而粗粝的氛围。开篇曲以粗犷奔跑般的节奏展示了主唱极具说服力的嗓音；唯一原创曲目运用口簧与风笛形成持续推进感；扬琴为传统叙事曲提供精致背景；终曲则是纯器乐演奏，口簧与长笛、弦乐交织，制造出令人兴奋的不稳定感。整体展现出远超新乐队水准的成熟度与完成度，独立数字发行的形式也表明这并非主流商业制作。

items._cn_summary: 本文并非传统意义上的乐评，而是热海未来音乐祭第8回的详细活动预告与节目介绍。音乐祭以即兴为核心理念，融合アイヌ传统口琴ムックリ、南印度古典剧クーリヤッタム与ナンギャールクートゥ、舞台美术工坊及街头行进表演等多元形式，呈现跨地域、跨领域的实验性演出。出演者包括坂田明、卷上公一、町田康等日本即兴与前卫音乐重要人物，亦有韩国与荷兰活动的鼓手Sun Mi Hong参演。节目编排强调现场性、跨文化对话与地方空间结合，透过温泉街区的散步式演出与工作坊将参与者纳入创作过程。整体而言，节目设计与音乐节概念颇具艺术野心，但因内容性质为活动公告而非音乐评论，缺乏对演出声响与艺术质量的实际评析。

items.body: Nate Mercereau Fantastic Thoughts Perennial session man shows exactly what he's capable of Fantastic Thoughts by Nate Mercereau In 2022, Andre 3000 was beginning work on his solo debut New Blue Sun. It was to be a total left turn from his ‘Hey Ya!’ heyday, and so Three Stacks tasked LA drummer and producer Carlos Niño with assembling a killer jazz ensemble to really get the best out of his flutework. The guitarist Niño brought in would prove crucial, filling the empty spaces with shimmering textures and helping to tie the electroacoustic jams together. “He’s a magician,” Andre 3000 said: “he hardly ever sounds like he is playing a guitar.” That guitarist was Nate Mercereau, a precociously talented multi-instrumentalist with a wild CV. Mercereau worked as... The post Nate Mercereau – Fantastic Thoughts appeared first on The Quietus.
items._genre: experimental jazz / electronic / ambient fusion / improvised music
items._cn_summary: Nate Mercereau 是洛杉矶的吉他手与多乐器演奏者，曾参与 Andre 3000 首张个人专辑的录音工作。在那张以笛声和电声即兴为核心的专辑中，他负责填充声音空间，以闪烁的纹理将电子原声即兴段落串联起来，被合作者称为声音上的魔法师。《Fantastic Thoughts》是他个人的创作专辑，从标题和此前的工作脉络来看，延续了他在爵士即兴、电子原声融合与氛围化声音设计方面的探索，以吉他为核心乐器，在自由即兴与电子处理之间寻找平衡。作为常年参与各类录音的 session musician，这张专辑是他展示个人完整创作意图的作品，融合了爵士演奏者的即兴能力与电子音乐制作人的声音处理手法，体现出 LA 地下爵士与电子场景交汇处的审美倾向。

items.body: Review by tszirmay — By sheer perseverance and absolute luck , I landed on an online video of a piece from their previous debut album, recently released in September 2025. It was so good, I immediately purchased it on Bandcamp, as well as this November 2025 one. Why, may you ask? A multitude of conspirators united in getting me hooked on this new trouvaille, starting with the country of origin Poland, being an absolute well of incredible music in the past 40 years and still going strong. Secondly, my tastes have evolved very much into a definite zone of admiration for expressive bass guitar lines, faithfully adorned with terrific e-piano, organ and synths that come straight out of the instrumental jazz-rock, groove-fusion era of the late 60s and 70s (think Brian Auger, Booker T and the MGs and such) , all propulsed by a robustly-appointed beat factory. The energy is palpable, the passion overtly addictive and the mood positive and buoyant. If you are looking for depressive sonic compliance, listen away in another direction. The band is a trio (yup, no guitars) that favours a jumpy, organic, raw and yet plush style that could easily define the modern electro-jazz-disco-funk hybrid jam that one could enjoy with acts like Tobor Experiment, Bottazz!, London Underground, Project Gemini and surely many others yet to discover. Mind music one can dance to, tap fingers or feet uncontrollably and just smile along for the ride. Keyboardist extraordinaire Roman Wrobleski , bassist Orz and immaculate drummer Jacek Rezner combine to create real palpitating pieces that ooze class, sweat and brawn all in one groove.One can easily snap their fingers to the cool Pacific Coast luxuriance on "California Plum Color", a perfect introduction to their suave style, as described above, emitting a vintage vibe, not too far removed from those Ocean Eleven etc.. soundtracks. What makes this so compelling is the occasional twist in alterations, boldly inserting pools of effects and creative deflection to the highly melodic foundation. Roman's fingers dance over the ivories with skill and inspiration yet rigidly protecting the rhythm divine groove at all times.The similarly sized "Gradient 1" and "Gradient 2" for a one-two punch showcases the smoothness of tone and color, occasional swerves into hypnotic repetition that surely provides for bodily reactions to take place. Rezner's manic drumming sits well with the plump bass lines that cast the needed spell. The buzzing cymbal work in particular is noteworthy, a sizzling shuffle that swats indifference away like flies, urging, pushing and leaning on the pulse courageously throughout. The sparkling e-piano not only offers melody but also a high energy percussive slant that keeps the juices flowing, like layers of sonic terraces one after the other.The trio really keeps the pot boiling on the frothy "Antelope Color", the focus openly targeting the synthesized electronics as they become overtly experimental in the background, Rezner pounding hard and fast, Wroblewski whipping out a leaping organ rant and the bass keeping it all neat and orderly in between. Fascinating ! "Summer End Color" was leaving a hot and sweaty realm, gently blowing into a cooler expanse, as if frigid Arctic squalls intended to relieve the heat. The warm speed slowly winds down to a reverential ending.The highlight is revealed on the tow final pieces the "Oolong Color" clocking in at 4:39 and its extended 7:45 version, a dozen minutes of exuberant and expressive fusion of a substantial variety of stylistic categories that also includes ambient seagull screeches, a funk-jazz rhythmic palisade, and some grove-induces aural hallucinations, especially evident in the extended version, where there are some slight Ozric Tentacles sonorities (if one omits the psychedelic Ed Wynne guitar pirouettes) that keep the dreams alive. Orz and Rezner in particular revel in the electro-reggae shuffle, conjuring jungle fauna and flora images that feel like lotus leaves unfolding or giant mushrooms sprouting from the ground (artwork ideas for Roger Dean).Another precious discovery I intend to cherish, as I simply adore this kind of music.4.5 colour blinds

items.body: Review by Abrasmatheus — The World of Genius Hans is an excellent example of the more jazz-oriented, experimental and eccentric side of early-70s progressive rock. The second album by the French band Moving Gelatine Plates, it dives deeply into the Canterbury Scene, combining progressive rock, jazz-rock, psychedelia and a good dose of satirical humor.What stands out the most is the complexity of the compositions. The songs seem carefully constructed, especially in their instrumental sections, featuring several rhythmic changes, thematic development and interesting interactions between the instruments. Despite this complexity, the changes generally feel natural and do not seem to exist merely to show off technical skills.The instrumentation is probably one of the album's greatest strengths. Guitars, bass, drums, keyboards, saxophones, flute and other instruments create a very rich sound. The musicians demonstrate good technical ability, but fortunately the virtuosity remains subordinate to the compositions. The result is a technically sophisticated album without becoming excessively cold or purely focused on instrumental showmanship.The influence of the Canterbury Scene is quite evident, especially from bands such as Caravan and Soft Machine. Some elements also recall the more eclectic and experimental side of progressive rock. Nevertheless, Moving Gelatine Plates manages to develop a personality of its own, particularly through its humor, unusual instrumentation and combination of jazz and progressive rock structures.The title track, "The World of Genius Hans," is the main highlight. At around 14 minutes, it features numerous rhythmic changes, strong jazz influences and interesting synthesizer passages. It summarizes the album's overall concept very well and demonstrates the band's ability to work with long compositions without abandoning melodic ideas."Funny Doll" and "Astromonster" are also among the best moments of the album. The former presents a very characteristic approach from the band, while "Astromonster" explores a more psychedelic and experimental atmosphere.Another positive aspect is the album's cohesion. Despite the variety of ideas and styles, the album works very well as a complete listening experience. There is a relatively consistent musical identity throughout the record, and the alternation between more intense, jazzy, psychedelic and humorous moments keeps the listener interested.The production also deserves praise. Even though this is an early-70s recording, the instruments are relatively easy to distinguish, allowing the listener to appreciate the details of the complex arrangements.I would not consider the album perfect. Although the compositions are very interesting, a few passages can feel somewhat random, and the influence of other Canterbury Scene bands is quite noticeable. Therefore, despite its quality and complexity, I would not place it among the absolutely essential progressive rock albums.Nevertheless, The World of Genius Hans is highly recommended for fans of the Canterbury Scene, jazz-rock and the more experimental sides of progressive rock. It should also appeal to jazz-fusion fans who are interested in exploring progressive rock.Best tracks:1. The World of Genius Hans2. Funny Doll3. AstromonsterHonorable mention: Les �tres d'Or (bonus track)A highly recommended album for fans of Canterbury Scene, jazz-rock and progressive rock, particularly for listeners who enjoy complex arrangements, unusual instrumentation, frequent rhythmic changes and a humorous experimental approach.

items._cn_summary: Moving Gelatine Plates的第二张专辑《The World of Genius Hans》是法国乐队对七十年代初坎特伯雷场景的深度致敬，将前卫摇滚、爵士摇滚与迷幻元素编织在一起，并融入讽刺性的幽默感。乐评重点赞赏了作品在编曲上的复杂性——多乐器配置涵盖吉他、贝斯、鼓、键盘、萨克斯与长笛，节奏变化频繁但过渡自然，技术服务于结构而非炫耀。十四分钟长的同名标题曲浓缩了整体概念，展示乐队驾驭长篇作品的能力。《Funny Doll》与《Astromonster》分别呈现乐队特有的幽默气质与迷幻实验氛围。整体凝聚力较强，制作清晰度在同时代作品中值得肯定。乐评亦指出个别段落略显随意，对坎特伯雷乐队（Caravan、Soft Machine）的借鉴较为明显，因此未将其列为绝对必听之作。

items.body: Review by siLLy puPPy — Like neighboring Spain, the Portuguese prog scene was stifled along with other artistic innovationsdue to the stranglehold dictatorship known as the Estado Novo which retained its iron grip until the1974 Carnation Revolution which at long last brought Portugal into the modern world. While artistswere prevented from offering their free expression, they were certainly aware of the developmentsthroughout the rest of Europe however two bands didn't wait for the revolution to unfold but rathergot the prog party started before the big change. The first was Quarteto 1111 and following suit in1971 was PESTRUS CASTRUS formed by brothers Pedro Castro and Jos� Castro, the former of whom servedas the band's moniker albeit in a Latinized form. The brothers recruited Julio Pereira (guitars) andRui Reis (keyboards) from the band Play Boys and eventually drummer Jo�o Seixas. Unlike Quarteto1111 though, PESTRUS CASTRUS began as a prog band from the very start albeit one was more crossoverin nature bridging the psychedelic rock 60s with the more elaborately designed prog that wassweeping the world by 1973.The band spawned two EPs, "Marasmo" and "Tudo Isto, Tudo Mais" as tantalizing warmups but alreadymastered the art of catchy melodic hooks cradled in the symphonic prog stylistic approach of theera. The first debut full-length followed in 1973. MESTRE ("Master") was a latecomer to the overallprog game by barely making it out in 1973 released in December but formerly announced Portugal wasready to join the rest of the world and as a result MESTRE is considered the very first Portugueseprog album which boldly emerged before the Estado Novo had even crumbled and unsurprisingly wascompletely banned by the Censorship Commission. And it's no wonder as the lyrics (in Portuguese)were confrontational and challenged the government directly by including adapted works of Portugueseand Brazilian antiestablishment poets that included Alexandre O'Neill, Fernando Pessoa, Sophia deMello Breyner Andresen, Manuel Bandeira, and Bocage.Stylistically MESTRE is quite diverse hosting a collection of 11 tracks that run the gamut ofkeyboard-oriented symphonic prog, 60s psychedelic rock and contemplative folk with strong melodicdevelopments. While the style is somewhat similar to the symphonic prog of Italian artists, PESTRUSCASTRUS wasn't as technically proficient nor were the compositions steeped in classical overtones.The basis for the song structures is clearly more steeped in 60s psychedelic scenes only adapted tothe symphonic sensibilities that were en vogue in the early 1970s. The Beatles was a clear influenceon the melodic hooks as well as the occasional delving into the McCartney'esque vaudeville styledshow tune "Macaco" while "S.A.R.L" takes on a Santana-styled Latin rock vibe. Despite these outliersthough the album is primarily steeped with rather nonchalant contemplative symphonic rock tracksthat bring the more atmospheric moments of PFM or Banco to mind.Overall MESTRE is a dramatic take on melodic symphonic prog that may prove to be to mainstreamsounding for many but when taken into context with the barriers put in place for albums like this toemerge in the first place, it's an absolute testament of fortitude that this album was released asearly as it was. Perhaps not the masterpiece many have touted it as but surely an excellent slice ofmelodic symphonic prog polished with a fiery passion fueled by a perception that freedom was justaround the corner. While the Portuguese language may be a barrier for lyrical comprehension formany, the music itself is well worth the price of admission with beautifully constructed songs thatevoke all the wild mood swings of a classic prog album from the era. The band would go on hiatus forseveral years with the two brothers studying abroad to earn degrees in economics and engineering,the band returned in 1979 to release one more album "Ascen��o e Queda" before calling it quits forgood. While the band never achieved any significant success, it has indeed become legendary on thePortuguese prog scene.
items._genre: symphonic prog / psychedelic rock / folk rock
items._cn_summary: 1973年葡萄牙独裁统治末期，PESTRUS CASTRUS发行了被认为是该国首张前卫摇滚专辑《Mestre》，因歌词引用反建制诗人作品而遭审查禁播。专辑融合了键盘主导的交响前卫、六十年代迷幻摇滚与沉思民谣三种风格，十一首曲目跨度丰富。在旋律创作上明显受到披头士影响，'Macaco'带有麦卡特尼式的杂耍风格，'S.A.R.L'则呈现桑塔纳式的拉丁摇滚质感。整体编曲以六十年代迷幻为根基，适配七十年代初的交响前卫审美，但相比意大利同类乐队如PFM与Banco，技术层面与古典深度均有所不及。专辑作为葡萄牙前卫音乐的开端具有历史意义，其在高压政治环境下诞生并被禁的历史背景，赋予了这张作品独特的文化价值，但风格上仍属传统交响前卫范畴内的常规实践。

items.body: Top PickDreadnought – Wars of Spirit // Wards of Light (progressive post-metal) Like Eden said, Wars of Spirit // Wards of Light is a more direct, yet still expansive album for Dreadnought, that blends the bassy, post-metal rumble of previous benchmark Emergence (2019) with the expansive, progressive soundscapes of their other, perhaps more progressive material. The way it balances all these elements is truly impressive, painting a lush soniscape that is at once oppressive and inviting, and the perfect backdrop for Kelly Schilling's Kate Bush-esque wails, which are themselves as equally unhinged-sounding as they are controlled.This band might not seem like my usual cup of tea, but Dreadnought have always been exceptions to whatever rules you want to throw at them. when something is done with such obvious passion and mastery it's impossible to resist, and Wars of Spirit // Wards of Light might just be their best album yet. items._cn_summary: 本文并非传统意义上的专辑乐评，而是关于英国制作人Ken Thomas的职业生涯综述报告。报告追溯了他从Trident Studios学徒起步，到为Wire、Psychic TV等制作尖锐实验声响，再到与Sigur Rós合作探索交响化氛围声响，以及与M83合作处理合成器流行质地的完整轨迹。文章重点分析了他将工作室视为乐器的哲学方法论，包括在冰岛改造游泳池作为录音场地的实践。对于关注工业、后朋克、氛围流行和实验制作领域的听众来说，这份报告揭示了一位横跨多个时代与技术流派的制作人如何在不同美学之间架桥，但其形式偏重学术综述而非音乐批评本身。

items.body: Karine Polwart has proved herself to be an exceptional talent as a singer and songwriter for many years, all the way back to her time with Malinky (the song �Thaney� was a revelation). As a solo artist she�s grown and continually expanded her horizons, coming now to Windblown , a project that began life seven years ago, when Polwart, along with sound designer and composer Pippa Murphy, was artist in residence at Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh. The album, with its stage show and book, tells the story of the garden�s oldest specimen, a Sabal palm tree ( Sabal bermudana ), which was gently felled in 2021, and contained a surprise nobody had expected. The tree is the starting point. From there, imagination runs free. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan It�s an album of voice and piano (the outstanding, sympathetic Dave Milligan), and, for all its global outlook on connections, one that�s very rooted in Scotland. You can hear it on the opening track, �Hear The Rigging/Last In Line,� where the melody becomes a slow, aching lament that would sound completely natural on the pipes. The stripped-down sound gives the songs both crafted stateliness and real intimacy. Each one is an exhalation, a memory, a celebration and exploration, with recurring phrases in the words and music acting as touchstones � or even hooks; they certainly stick in the mind. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan In many ways, this is a modest album, with piano, voice and light, judicious soundscaping. It won�t overpower with noise. Yet at the same time, it�s epic, a look at history, at the flow and grandeur of nature, and the things we all carry within us. The music, and especially Polwart�s warm, compassionate voice, envelop the listener, and makes them a participant, not an observer, but a part of the journey and the history. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan The irony arrives at the end, when the venerable old tree is down, and seeds are examined. What people for two hundred years had believed to be a Sabal bermudana turns out to be something different, a Sabal mexicana � and one of the small plants fill grow where it�s forerunner once stood. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan Like music, plants keep to a different time � and this album/book/show give the tree the requiem it deserves, as well as hope for the future. items._cn_summary: 这张专辑源自艺术家在爱丁堡皇家植物园的驻留项目，以园中最古老的标本——一棵于2021年被砍伐的棕榈树为起点展开叙事构想。专辑由人声、钢琴与精心配制的声景构成，Pippa Murphy负责声音设计，Dave Milligan担任钢琴演奏。作品虽以钢琴与人声为主，但带有实验性的声景层处理，歌词与音乐中反复出现的乐句作为记忆锚点贯穿全篇。苏格兰文化根源深植其中，开篇曲调缓慢哀婉，具有风笛般的气质。专辑主题跨越历史、自然的时间流逝与个体记忆，Polwart温暖的声线将听众带入旅程之中。结尾处揭示了一个反讽性的发现：两百年来被认定为某种棕榈的树木实际上是另一个物种，而新的幼苗将在旧树的位置生长，为这张既是挽歌又面向未来的作品画上句点。

items.body: Sudan Dudan is a Norwegian duo, Marit Karlberg and Anders Erik R�ine, who have released four albums over the last twenty years. On M�rke refrenger , their fifth, they are joined by Hans Hulb�kmo and Magnus Skavhaug Nergaard, contributing instrumentally and with the production. There are eight songs on the album with accompaniment principally led by acoustic guitar, augmented by fiddles, langeleik, lyre, jaws harp and more. The opening track, �Gard og grind� (�Fence and gate�) is a fine introduction to what is to come: finger-picked acoustic guitar, fiddle, bass and snare-drum played with brushes leading into the harmonized vocal, together creating an alluring sound drawing the listener in. M�rke refrenger by Sudan Dudan The mood of the album, reflected in its title which translates as �Dark Refrains,� is not always dark, but most of the material, including the title track, certainly has a reflective quality. According to the press release �the lyrics smoulder with unease about the present and the future, while looking back to the myths and riddles of the past. They speak of the earth, the sun, the moon, stars and planets, of lost brothers, quarrelling sisters, loss and grief, of the power of imagination, and of the answers to the simplest and most difficult riddles.� The lyrics of all the songs, in Norwegian, are included in the sleeve notes and while a hasty online translation can aid with some understanding, the full meanings tend to remain cryptic, but there is a sense that words and music complement each other. M�rke refrenger by Sudan Dudan For all its dark moodiness, M�rke refrenger does have its lighter moments. �Bagatelle� recalls and reinvents the melody of a well-known French song, adding some off-kilter harmonies, while �Rulleball� is more characteristically Norwegian, employing a vocal style known as tralling in which words are replaced by a vocalization of the melody, originally used to accompany dances when no instrument was available. No translation necessary there. M�rke refrenger by Sudan Dudan The final track �Skriften p� veggen� (�the writing on the wall�) features, for the only time on the album, electric guitar. The sound is deep and twangy, shades of Duane Eddy or a David Lynch soundtrack and it works very well. All in all a fine, imaginatively conceived and beautifully produced record, available as a download or vinyl. Find the artists online. items.body:
According to its founder, Eugene Rodriguez, who also sings and plays on the record, Los Cenzontles is a �musical group and non-profit organization, which I founded over thirty years ago.�  As he continues in the album�s liner notes, the group �has a long history of producing projects exploring Mexico�s deep roots and our connections with various traditions that, so far, have included Irish, Louisiana Creole, Cuban, American cowboy, classical, pop, rock, and blues�, the latest of which is
Adios Ke Aloha: Waves of the Same Sea
. Los Cenzontles translates to the mockingbird, or, from its Aztec root word, the bird of four hundred voices. This is a fitting name for the range of musical diversity represented here.
With songs sung in Spanish, Hawaiian, and English, the concept traces back to the legacy of Mexican cowboys who travelled from California to the Hawaiian Islands to wrangle the long-horned cattle introduced there in the nineteenth century. They also brought the guitar. The 16 tracks feature old Hawaiian songs with new Spanish lyrics, old Mexican songs with new Hawaiian lyrics, new compositions, and traditional Americana. Yet it is an entirely cohesive musical package held together by dense arrangements of ukuleles, guitars, Mexican harp, and accordion.
Sonny Lim & David Hidalgo
Besides their distinctive voices, the headline artists Taj Mahal and David Hidalgo provide the gravitas and musicianship that their long and distinguished careers have earned. According to the liner notes, they were the catalysts behind the project and facilitated the choice of songs, arrangements, and played a range of instruments. On vocals they are joined by Hawaiian natives Gary Haleamau, Sheldeen Haleamau, Sonny Lim, and long-time Cenzontles member Fabiola Trujillo.
Deportee
To give a taste of the sessions, included before the traditional �Fishin� Blues� is Taj Mahal teaching the musicians how to play it. Sung by David Hildalgo,  the lovely �A Matter of Time� comes from the 1984 album
Will the Wolf Survive
by his most famous project, Los Lobos. Another standout for me, �Navegar� features a slack string guitar solo reminiscent of Duane Eddie and one of many tasty lap steel turns by Sonny Lim. Their interpretation of Woody Guthrie's �Deportee� moves into social commentary, highlighting the cruel realities of being a migrant worker in America.
Vaquero Paniolo
Recorded over five days, mostly live in one room at the Los Cenzontles headquarters in San Pablo, California, including the talents of some of their academy�s students, the recording has real spontaneity to it. Arrangements are stretched by improvisations, sometimes by several different instruments on a single tune. The project also represents a great spirit of cooperation and diversity of language, culture, age, and gender. It includes the inputs of musical legends, seasoned pros, and amateurs. The wonderfully rich and often stereotyped musical cultures of both Mexico and Hawaii are represented here with the authenticity of lived experience.
Adios Ke Aloha: Waves of the Same Sea
is a worthy addition to Los Cenzontles� important work. Quoting Rodriguez again, �Culture is a fabric within which we are all woven.�

items._cn_summary: 专辑以墨西哥牛仔与夏威夷牧场主的历史联系为线索，将西班牙语、夏威夷语和英语歌曲交织在一起，用尤克里里、墨西哥竖琴和手风琴构建密集而统一的编曲。Taj Mahal与David Hidalgo作为核心人物参与选曲、编曲及乐器演奏，与多位夏威夷本土歌者及学院学员合作，录音在加州圣巴勃罗的单间内以近乎现场的方式完成，保留了大量即兴段落。木吉他、滑棒钢弦与多语种人声构成跨太平洋的文化对话，Woody Guthrie的经典作品被以社会评论角度重新演绎，触及移民劳工议题。整体呈现出文化、语言、年龄与性别层面的协作精神，但并未涉及电子或实验元素。

items.body:
The musical partnership between Kalaniemi and Alakotila has thrived over a remarkable 35 years, long enough to the Finnish pair to develop a stunning intimacy and telepathy. Kalaniemi is a lovingly melodic accordion player, with a sharp ear for a good tune, building each one into a thing of great beauty, while pianist Alakotila not only supports her but adds enough of his own to help transform every piece into a glistening gem.
There�s a sense of calmness to the work here, a long, sweet exhalation between two instrumentalists who are deep enough in sync to allow seamless improvisation beyond any written score and carry the listeners along with them. For much of the album, it�s just the pair of them, including Kalaniemi�s wordless voice, as on the opener, the tradional �Lyck�nskan.� She does charmingly sing lyrics on the title track, written by Lasse M�rtenson, with the sound there neatly and sparingly expanded with the addition of a string quartet.
Morgondimma
There are several original pieces alongside the tradition, with Kalaniemi�s �Hambo Vid F�bodan� a real standout, and it�s perhaps inevitable on any disc featuring accordion that a Piazzolla tune should be included, brings its own shadows to the whole (�Oblivion�). And, this being Finland, a tango is almost obligatory, in this case Alakotila�s �Tango Berlin.�
Tango Berlin
There�s a gentle, dreamlike quality to so much of this, flowing and mellifluous. The pieces aren�t an arena for showy virtuosity. Instead, the two musicians serve the tune, exploring and genuinely enjoying their performances.
It won�t shake the earth, but it makes for some true listening beauty.

items._cn_summary: 这是一张芬兰手风琴与钢琴二重奏专辑，呈现两位音乐人长达三十五年的默契配合。手风琴演奏旋律抒情，钢琴在支撑之余加入自身色彩，二人无需谱面约束即兴推进，营造出宁静绵长的呼吸感。专辑收录传统曲目与原创作品，部分曲目加入弦乐四重奏点缀，曲目编排以服务旋律为核心，探索多于炫技。整体呈现出温和梦幻、流畅甜美的质地，虽未涉及实验性音色设计或跨界融合，但在北欧民谣范畴内展现了成熟的器乐对话与情感表达。来自芬兰地区的传统器乐组合具备一定地域文化特色，专辑定位偏向精致器乐民谣而非主流商业制作。

items.body:
Sometime in 1986, perhaps in a Paris caf�, Dominique Cravic, a singer, guitarist, and musical archivist, met Robert Crumb, an underground cartoonist, banjo and mandolin player, and jug-band aficionado. Over a few glasses of marc, to continue to speculate, they conjured up the idea for Les Primitifs du futur.  Since then, they have recorded an impossible-to-categorize series of albums, with cover illustrations by Crumb, of which Les Crimes du Mussette is the fifth.
Weird and wonderful, it sounds like they rooted through an attic full of 78 RPM records, scribbled down some arrangements, and then played them on a collection of instruments they found in another attic, including accordion, sax, xylophone, clarinet, banjo, ukulele, theremin, Hawaiian guitar, bagpipe chanter (I�m guessing here), and musical saw.
Ne tirez pas sur le pianiste (excerpt)
The 27 short tracks are mostly voiced by Cravic, who talk-sings in the manner of an everyman Maurice Chevalier. He is often accompanied by the accordion, a customary instrument in the bal-musette style that remains a strong element of the eclectic range of styles they have managed to synthesize. They also include ragtime, jug, French chanson, and, to my ears, skiffle,  just to get the list started.
Ukulele Lady (excerpt)
The liner notes point out that �Les Crimes du Musette is also a gold mine for scholars, a veritable treasure trove.� Exploring the treasures is beyond my scope here, as each tune has a long history. A highlight for me is the humorous �Ukulele Lady� from 1925, which first delighted me on Arlo Guthrie�s 1971 album
Hobo�s Lullaby
. The song has also been covered by Bing Crosby, Peter Sellers, and Bette Midler.
N'oublie pas Gr�co (excerpt)
A more serious item is �N�oublie pas Gr�co� (Don�t Forget Gr�co�)  is a tribute to the legendary chanteuse and heroine of the French Resistance, Juliette Gr�co, who died in 2020. You will also hear old chestnuts like �Fum�e aux yeux� (�Smoke Gets in Your Eyes�),  �Boude pas� (�Take Five�), and �Prive d�amour� (�As Time Goes By�).
This record is a curiosity, but it is performed by serious musicians with total commitment. In this, I was reminded of the similarly indefinable Dan Hicks & the Hot Licks. Long-forgotten music and abandoned styles are given new animation with obvious enthusiasm and care. Speaking about himself and his collaborators, many of whom are in their seventies, Dominique Cravic says, �The young have fire, but we have light.� In its own little corner,
Les Crimes du Musette
shines bright.

Vanishment
(Review)

Genuine Negro Jig
(Review)
items.label: Buda Musique
items._genre: bal-musette / French chanson / ragtime / jug band / eclectic folk
items._cn_summary: 这是Les Primitifs du Futur的第五张专辑，由Dominique Cravic领衔，Robert Crumb担任封面插画。专辑以法国bal-musette传统为基底，融合拉格泰姆、jug band、法国香颂、skiffle等多种风格，呈现出难以归类的杂糅特质。演奏使用手风琴、萨克斯、班卓琴、尤克里里、theremin、夏威夷吉他等多种乐器，营造出翻阅老78转唱片藏品的怀旧氛围。27首短曲由Cravic以近似法国香颂的念白式演唱呈现，曲目涵盖1920年代老歌翻唱以及对刚于2020年去世的法国抵抗运动女歌手Juliette Gréco的致敬。乐评将其比作同样难以定义的Dan Hicks & His Hot Licks，认为这是一张由认真音乐人全心投入演绎的好奇之作，为被遗忘的音乐风格注入新的活力。

items.body: In August 1819, tens of thousands of working men and women gathered in St. Peter�s Field in Manchester to hear the politician Henry Hunt speak. They were difficult times, many still out of work after the Napoleonic wars, rising prices and low wages � and always those at the bottom of the heap suffering. Hunt was a famed orator, a man on the side of the people, able to stir and inspire with his voice. Although the gathering was peaceful, the size of the crowd terrified the magistrates, who panicked and imagined an uprising. They sent in half-trained dragoons and the cavalry, who rode down, slashed and killed without compunction or compassion. In the end, 18 died and up to 700 were wounded. It was a stain on the nation, an outrage; prompting Percy Shelley, one of the poetic giants of the age, to write The Masque of Anarchy , with its famous lines: �Rise like Lions after slumber / in unvanquishable number / She your chains to earth like dew / Which in sleep had fallen on you / Ye are many - they are few.� Peterloo, as people called it, remains one of the seminal events in English working-class history, one that Sean Cooney of the Young 'Uns has revisited for this album of original songs, which is lavishly presented in a book with contemporary letters, political cartoons and illustrations to create a multimedia event. It�s ambitious, no doubt about that, and he�s selected some great talent to help � guitarist Sam Carter, the almost ubiquitous fiddler/singer Eliza Carthy, Ben Nicholls supplying background and texture on various instruments, and the Lancashire industrial ballad singer Jennifer Reid, who doubles as narrator. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid For a small ensemble, they make a powerful noise. The songs capture the feel of the day; the anticipation and excitement at the summer gathering, the joy that turns to terror and flight as the troops charge, then the bitter, mournful aftermath, voiced some powerful melodies and very well-chosen images. As a writer, Cooney often focuses on the personal in the small tales of people like �Sam Bamford� and �Mary Fildes,� while the three short pieces that comprise �The Monkey Rides The Mare� capture the bluster and arrogance of the soldiers. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid Cooney is a persuasive singer, and on this heartfelt project, he puts plenty of emotion into his voice. Having two other outstanding vocalists alongside him makes for a wonderful triple threat. In these days when governments across the world are cracking down on protest, this stands as a sobering and very timely reminder. It�s a history lesson, yes, but the detail of the history stays in the book, while the music creates a set of songs that will resonate and remain for a long time. Find the artist online. Further reading: The Young'uns - Tiny Notes (Review) Ben Nicholls - Duets
items.label: Hudson
items._genre: folk / historical ballad / narrative folk
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑围绕1819年曼彻斯特圣彼得广场大屠杀（Peterloo）展开，Sean Cooney创作原创歌曲，以音乐重现这一英国工人运动史上的标志性事件。专辑以书配CD形式呈现，收录当时的信件、政治漫画与插图，构成多媒体体验。音乐上采用英格兰东北传统民谣风格，邀请小提琴手Eliza Carthy、吉他手Sam Carter等合作，歌曲捕捉集会日的期待、骑兵冲击时的恐慌，以及事后的悲恸。Cooney擅长通过小人物的视角讲述历史，三段式作品《The Monkey Rides The Mare》刻画士兵的傲慢。专辑在当代抗议遭压制的语境下具有现实意义，将历史细节留于书中，让音乐本身传递共鸣。

items.body:
I want to personally direct you to a remarkable piece of music titled "Two Views of a Prayer," composed and written by
David Dzubinski
as part of the
Prism Quartet
's new series of collaborations called
Unlocking Your Inner Composer
. If you have listened to my radio programs, you are probably familiar with the quartet's ground-breaking, genre-blurring music. If not, there's no better introduction than this.
Performed in November of 2025 at the Free Library of Philadelphia, they invited vocalist
Ursula Rucker
, percussionist
Tyshawn Sorey
, and violinist
Carlos Santiago
to collaborate on the arrangement and performance of Dzubinski's composition. It travels from raw to lyrical and back in the course of just under 4 minutes, with both finesse and energy. - Cliff Furnald, editor
Find Prism Quartet online.
items._genre: contemporary classical / chamber / avant-garde jazz / spoken word
items._cn_summary: 这张作品由David Dzubinski创作，Prism萨克斯四重奏与诗人Ursula Rucker、打击乐手Tyshawn Sorey、小提琴家Carlos Santiago合作完成，属于四重奏"Unlocking Your Inner Composer"系列的一部分。2025年11月在费城自由图书馆演出录制，时长不足四分钟，音乐在粗粝与抒情之间快速切换，展现出编制与即兴之间的张力。评论将其定位为跨界合作的范例，融合了器乐重奏、人声与打击乐的多元表达。Tyshawn Sorey的参与为作品注入了自由爵士与即兴音乐的色彩，而萨克斯四重奏的编制则保留了当代古典的气息。整体来看，这是一次将作曲家的素材交由不同背景的演奏者共同诠释的实验性项目，但乐评篇幅较短，缺少对声音细节与结构走向的深入分析。

items.artist: Gunfire Survivors speak from The Forgotten Parts of Chicago
items.excerpt:
Editor's note:
When this set of recordings came to me, I was at a loss as to how to share it. It's not music, in any traditional sense (although there is some freestyle rapping), and a 'review' of such an artifact of reality seems superfluous to the content. items.body: Editor's note: When this set of recordings came to me, I was at a loss as to how to share it. It's not music, in any traditional sense (although there is some freestyle rapping), and a 'review' of such an artifact of reality seems superfluous to the content. Instead, I asked sound recordist Ian Brennan if I could simply use his own brief commentary and the recordings he made on the street in Chicago. Twenty-five people afflicted by gun violence participated, many from the very block we�d setup on. Many neighbors were pulled-in spontaneously. Almost every one in the community had been impacted by violence somehow� both on the receiving and the inflicting end, and many both. One woman had just come from a memorial service, another was on her way. That�s how far-reaching the violence. Almost no one went untouched. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors By chance, we convened on the day that Trump ordered the deployment of the National Guard to the city. The recording took place on the front porch of the leader's ninety-four-year-old grandmother's house�right in the heart of the ��hood,� beneath the Midway Airport�s landing path. A pair of stray pitfalls stalked the block. But the grandmother warned not of gunshots, but the mosquitoes in her yard. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors We were in a section of town that one man defined as �the forgotten parts.� Just a short jaunt from the designer clothes shops and posh hotels of the city�s Magnificent Mile, the Southside spawned such legendary Blues artists as Muddy Waters, Willie Dixon, and Howlin� Wolf. Jazz musicians like Lionel Hampton and even Benny Goodman, hailed from nearby. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors The participants ranged in age from seventeen to sixty-seven, but the pattern held true. The person who�d asserted �you�ll really want to hear my story,� was the least compelling. The reluctant, the most moving. One elder�s tough facade broke down as she shared how she�d lost both her sons. She tearfully apologized, �I�m sorry. I�m sorry. I�m sorry.� But she had nothing to be sorry for. Society is the one that owes the apology� for the staggering statistical inequities of which no reasonable defense can be made. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors Editor's note: The full set of recordings are available on Bandcamp. Any profits from this project will be donated to Cure Violence Global , who states that their mission is "advancing an evidence-based health approach to end violence globally." When I asked him about the background sounds, producer Ian Brennan added, "No music is added. It�s all sounds from the source environment. I also ran loops/drones on a different track in the background as they spoke, and when they ended up being incidentally/somewhat magically/eerily synchronous, that is what was used for a few pieces with 'accompaniment' like some of the rap freestyles."
items._genre: field recording / spoken word / documentary
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑并非传统意义上的音乐作品，而是声音记录者Ian Brennan在芝加哥南区街头录制的口述记录。参与者为二十五名枪支暴力幸存者，年龄从十七岁到六十七岁不等，他们在九十四岁祖母家前廊讲述自身经历。录制当天恰逢特朗普下令国民警卫队进驻芝加哥。专辑不添加任何音乐，背景音均为现场环境声——包括飞机降落路径下的噪音和街区的日常声响。这些口述呈现了暴力如何渗透社区每个角落，从失去两个儿子的老人反复道歉，到被社会遗忘的边缘地带。收益将捐赠给Cure Violence Global。作为田野录音与口述史的结合，这件作品具有强烈的社会纪实性质。

items.body: Review by ianjferris@gmail.com — This album is good. In fact it's very good. This is Neal Morse doing what Neal Morse does best - Progressive Rock Music. However (there's nearly always a "however", isn't there), I just can't get away from the fact (for me it's a fact) that this album sounds like a poor man's version of Transatlantic. I can't fault anything on the album - the music, the lyrics, the concept, the delivery and the production..... It's all very good. It's just that after playing cd 1 (sometimes I'll put on cd 2 first), I always reach for one of the Transatlantic albums (I have them all) in my vinyl collection. I just wonder, if Neal had condensed and confined this album to just one hour in length, would it have been a better and an easier listen. Yes, it would. So for me right now, just three stars.
items._genre: symphonic prog / progressive rock / neo-prog
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是Neal Morse乐队2016年的概念性交响前卫摇滚作品，以双CD的篇幅呈现完整的叙事结构。乐评人承认专辑在音乐品质、歌词深度、概念设计、现场演绎与制作水准上均无可挑剔，但指出其整体听感更像是Transatlantic乐队的低配版，缺乏独立辨识度。评论者强调，尽管每首曲目单独聆听都表现良好，但专辑篇幅过长导致整体聆听疲劳，若能压缩至一小时左右则会成为更紧凑的体验。音乐编排偏向传统前卫摇滚框架，以多乐章结构、键盘主导的旋律铺陈与复杂段落转换为特征，未展现出明显的跨界实验倾向。

items.body: Review by martindavey87 — 'The Piper At the Gates of Dawn' is the 1967 debut album by British rock band Pink Floyd. I always thought I was fine with experimental music, that I was open-minded enough to enjoy music that deviates from traditional songwriting practices. But perhaps I was wrong, because this album is completely and utterly "out there", and my delicate senses just can't cope. Somehow, Pink Floyd went from this album to eventually becoming one of the biggest bands in history, but I've yet to figure out how. I give them credit for completely throwing out the rulebook and thinking outside the box, but that doesn't necessarily mean these songs are actually any good. Because I find them boring as hell. The only one that remotely stands out to me, is 'The Gnome', but there's no way I'm going out of my way to listen to it. These might have been revolutionary and exciting back in the 1960's, but that's way ahead of my time, and by today's standards, I'll be having none of this. Still, regardless of this debut, Pink Floyd really are one of the biggest bands of all time, so I'll continue on my personal Floyd journey, and will see what their next album has in store for me.
items._genre: psychedelic rock / space rock / experimental rock
items._cn_summary: 这张1967年的专辑是Pink Floyd的首张作品，以早期迷幻摇滚与太空摇滚风格为核心，在那个年代具有相当的实验性探索。乐评人对专辑的整体评价偏负面，认为歌曲枯燥乏味，无法引起共鸣，但承认乐队在当时彻底打破了传统创作规则、跳出了常规思维框架。乐评唯一提及稍有亮点的是《The Gnome》一曲，但也未给予高度肯定。乐评人承认Pink Floyd后来成为历史上最伟大的乐队之一，但这张处女作以今天的标准来看显得过时。整体而言，这是一张在特定历史时期具有先锋意义的迷幻摇滚作品，但其风格与当代实验、前卫、电子等领域的深度融合相距较远，且乐评内容本身带有明显的否定倾向。

items.body: Los Angeles industrial/EBM act Frontal Boundary released “Alone EP” on 11 September 2026 through Alfa Matrix. The 8-track digital EP opens the door to the band’s forthcoming album “Shattered Mind”. The tracklist runs “Alone”, a cover of Garbage’s “Milk” featuring Kimber Parrish, an alternate version of “Alone”, and five remixes of the title track: by Assemblage 23, Protokoll 19, Reaper, Asphodel Ivory and The Axiom Divide. Alone EP by Frontal Boundary The title track explores isolation and grief, moving Frontal Boundary’s established dark electro toward more melodic, emotionally exposed songwriting. The five remixers each take “Alone” in a different direction, from Assemblage 23‘s atmospheric treatment to the harder electronic versions from Protokoll 19 and Reaper and the more experimental readings by Asphodel Ivory and The Axiom Divide. Frontal Boundary’s run on Alfa Matrix “Alone EP” follows a string of Alfa Matrix releases from the band. Frontal Boundary signed to the label in July 2025 with the “Hate” EP, followed by the 8-track “Faith” EP in September 2025 and the full-length album “Failure” on 12 December 2025, released as a digital edition and a limited 2CD set. The band closed out the “Failure” cycle with the 7-track “Burn” EP, featuring a cover of Filter’s “Hey Man Nice Shot”, on 24 April 2026. “Alone EP” is the band’s first release of the “Shattered Mind” era. About Frontal Boundary Frontal Boundary is a Los Angeles-based industrial/EBM project formed by Brendin Ross (ex-Bile, Dawn Of Ashes, Bornless Fire) in 2008. The project issued the demo “Never Ending” and the debut track “Mindfuck” in 2009, then released its first album, “Electronic Warfare”, on 6 January 2012, followed by a 2013 re-release as “Electronic Warfare V.2”. Ross toured the project alongside acts including God Module and Suicide Commando during this period. Vocalist Krz Souls (Dawn Of Ashes, Bornless Fire) joined in 2019, and the pair released the album “The Fall” on 19 March 2021. Synth player Jaysen Craves (Livernois) joined as a full member in 2023, the year Frontal Boundary signed to Re:Mission Entertainment. That signing led to the singles “Shutting Down” and “Without A Chance” and the album “Shutting Down” on 27 September 2024, followed by the remix collection “Shutting Down Remixed” in April 2025 and the “Hollow” EP with Unter Null in March 2025. Frontal Boundary moved to Alfa Matrix in 2025, releasing “Hate”, “Faith” and the album “Failure” before the “Burn” EP in April 2026. “Alone EP” continues that run and leads into the band’s fifth full-length album, “Shattered Mind”.

items.album: Ultravox’s ‘Rage in Eden’ turns 45 on 11 September

items.body: Ultravox released their fifth studio album, “Rage in Eden,” on 11 September 1981 through Chrysalis Records. The British new wave band recorded the nine-track album with producer Conny Plank at his studio near Cologne, West Germany, following the commercial breakthrough of “Vienna” a year earlier. “Rage in Eden” turns 45 this year. Where the “Vienna” sessions had been rehearsed live before the band entered the studio, Ultravox spent three months making “Rage in Eden,” building songs directly out of studio experiments; the title track grew from a backwards playback of vocals recorded for “I Remember (Death in the Afternoon).” The album runs 45 minutes and 34 seconds across nine tracks: “The Voice,” “We Stand Alone,” “Rage in Eden,” “I Remember (Death in the Afternoon),” “The Thin Wall,” “Stranger Within,” “Accent on Youth,” “The Ascent” and “Your Name (Has Slipped My Mind Again),” with the final three forming a continuous sequence on side two. Warren Cann (drums, electronic percussion, vocals), Chris Cross (bass, synthesizers, vocals), Billy Currie (synthesizers, piano, violin, viola) and Midge Ure (lead vocals, guitars, synthesizers) wrote and performed every song, with the original sleeve designed by Peter Saville Associates. Two singles from the album, “The Thin Wall” and “The Voice,” reached number 14 and number 16 on the UK singles chart, while the album itself peaked at number 4 and was certified Gold by the BPI. “Rage in Eden” streams on Spotify. About Ultravox Ultravox formed in London in April 1974 as Tiger Lily, led by Royal College of Art student Dennis Leigh, later known as John Foxx, alongside Chris Allen, later Chris Cross, on bass and Stevie Shears on guitar, joined that year by drummer Warren Cann and violinist Billy Currie. After several name changes the band signed to Island Records in 1976 and settled on Ultravox!, with the exclamation mark a reference to the krautrock band Neu!, while finishing its 1977 debut, “Ultravox!,” produced by Steve Lillywhite and Brian Eno. “Ha! Ha! Ha!” followed later that year, and 1978’s “Systems of Romance,” produced by Conny Plank, brought synthesizers to the front of the band’s sound. Island dropped Ultravox at the end of 1978, and John Foxx left in March 1979 to pursue a solo career. Midge Ure, previously of Slik and the Rich Kids and a touring member of Thin Lizzy, joined as vocalist, guitarist and keyboardist after collaborating with Billy Currie in the studio project Visage. The reshaped band signed to Chrysalis Records, and “Vienna,” released in July 1980 and again produced by Conny Plank, gave Ultravox its commercial breakthrough: the title single reached number 2 on the UK chart in January 1981. “Rage in Eden” followed on 11 September 1981, again recorded with Plank at his Cologne studio, reaching number 4 in the UK and earning a Gold certification from the BPI. Ultravox then worked with producer George Martin on 1982’s “Quartet,” which reached number 6 in the UK and produced four Top 20 singles, before self-producing 1984’s “Lament,” which included the UK number 3 hit “Dancing with Tears in My Eyes.” That November, Midge Ure co-wrote and produced Band Aid’s “Do They Know It’s Christmas?,” and Ultravox performed at Live Aid in 1985. Warren Cann left the band in 1986, and “U-Vox,” recorded with Big Country’s Mark Brzezicki on drums, became the final album of the original run before Ultravox split in 1987. Billy Currie led a new line-up through two further albums, “Revelation” (1993) and “Ingenuity” (1994), before the band dissolved again in 1996. The classic line-up of Cann, Cross, Currie and Ure reformed in 2008 for the “Return to Eden” tour and released the studio album “Brilliant” in May 2012, followed by a run of UK arena dates with Simple Minds that closed with a show at the O2 Arena in November 2013. Bassist Chris Cross died in March 2024, as Side-Line reported at the time. In October 2025, Chrysalis continued the catalogue’s reissue campaign with “The Collection (Deluxe Edition),” gathering the band’s 1980s singles. “Rage in Eden,” the fifth studio album that captured Ultravox at its most exploratory in the Cologne studio, turns 45 this year.

items._cn_summary: 本文为Ultravox第五张录音室专辑《Rage in Eden》发行45周年的纪念性回顾文章，主要以新闻资讯形式梳理专辑背景与制作信息。文章提及该专辑由德国制作人Conny Plank在科隆附近录音室制作，历时三个月完成，曲目构建直接源自录音室实验，例如标题曲由《I Remember》的人声倒放发展而来。专辑发行于Chrysalis Records，登上英国专辑榜第四名并获BPI金认证，两支单曲《The Thin Wall》与《The Voice》分别进入前二十。文章还简要回顾了乐队从Tiger Lily时期到签约Island、再转投Chrysalis的历程，以及Midge Ure取代John Foxx的成员更替。整体内容偏新闻报道性质，缺乏对音乐本体、声响设计或艺术价值的深入分析。

items.body:
Live at Rockpalast 1999
documents a command performance at the Loreley open-air amphitheater by Malcolm �Mac� Rebennack Jr., aka Dr. John. Rockpalast is a live-music TV show broadcast since 1974 by Westdeutscher Rundfunk (WDR), the archival source for this CD-DVD package, and coincidentally a remarkable cultural institution on its own terms.
Taped at the height of Dr. John�s international popularity, backing the singer-pianist-guitarist are New Orleans stalwarts Bobby Broom (guitar), David Barard (bass), and Herman Ernest (drums), a tight quartet that projects authority and engages the crowd from start to close.
A striking UNESCO-designated World Heritage Site set, the Loreley is a slate pinnacle on a mythic horseshoe bend of the Rhine River, memorializing an enduring German literary legend both tragic and romantic. The setting is thus well-suited for Mac�s mystical spirit and lyrical style. By this stage of his career, he characterized his live show as a Mardi Gras revue with a mix of New Orleans standards and some of his most recognizable compositions.
Hence, he opens with the NOLA classic �Iko, Iko,� a half-sung, half-chanted celebration of community participation in the renowned Mardi Gras second-line street procession. Then comes the in-your-face boast �Qualified,� wherein the singer warns, �I got the power to control / I can see clean through you, blind mole / I want to tell you now, I'm qualified / You know that I'm qualified.�
Any Dr. John fan will recognize �I Walk on Guilded Splinters,� a moody, percussively insistent, foreboding expression of the Night Tripper�s immersion in �funknology� (his term), gris-gris herbology, and hoodoo incantation, punctuated with jungle growls and cries, a loopy, spooky slide whistle, and an extended psych-guitar solo: �Walk thru the fire / Fly thru the smoke / See my enemy / At the end of dey rope.�
Every piece in this well- honed set deserves considertion. Although Dr John lived for many years in Los Angeles and New York, his enduring hometown connection shows in the fond inclusion of his own �Sweet Home New Orleans� and �Goin� Back to New Orleans,� and he nods to a key influence with a funky rendering of Duke Ellington�s �I'm Gonna Go Fishin�.� Among other gems are Mac�s Top�10 hit �Right Place, Wrong Time,� and the instantly recognizable closer, Earl King�s �Big Chief,� another Mardi Gras burner.
Regarding his live performance approach, per the notes, �I always play a little bit of everything. I think that�s what music�s about: a little bit of somethin� old, somethin� in the middle, somethin� new, and somethin� as yet uncreated.�
Dr John's�s longtime fans will welcome this archival gem, which also is a solid introduction for any late comers to the party. Surmounting the barriers of language and culture, the power of
At the Rockpalast
is also evident in the enthusiastic audience response. As he declares, �If you�re gonna get off on somethin� you don�t need to know nothin� about it. Music is a universal language.�

items.body: Review by greenpete — This solo live acoustic performance by Jansch occurred during one of his non-Pentangle creative peaks. A 1974 show before an enthusiastic but respectful audience in Glasgow, it is everything Jansch lovers could want: just the man and his acoustic guitar. Many of the songs are from one of his best solo releases, L.A. Turnaround (sympathetically produced by ex-Monkee Mike Nesmith). However, absent is Red Rhodes' arguably intrusive pedal steel guitar, which on Turnaround gave Bert's songs a faux-country feel.. Here, one can better get absorbed into Jansch's complex fingerpicking. But he also mixes up the picking with some melodic but powerful chord strumming, notably on the autobiographical song "When I Get Home," inspired by a beloved uncle of Jansch's. Similarly autobiographical is "Build Another Band," about Jansch's attempts to find sympathetic co-musicians. Other highlights are the Pentangle song "I've Got a Feeling" (melody borrowed from Miles Davis's "All Blues"), "One for Jo," the progressive folk-guitar mainstay "Angi," "Fresh as a Sweet Sunday Morning," and Jansch's gorgeous re-structuring of a classic Christmas carol, "In the Bleak Midwinter." On the latter song he good-naturedly scolds the crowd for not recognizing the title after he announces it. And that's another bonus with this concert: we get to hear a supremely confident Jansch converse between songs. He even delivers a cool potted history of the song, "Stone Monkey."Thus far this great concert is only available in CD form. But we can be grateful the sound quality is superb. NOTE: the PA track listing for song number 13 is wrong on two counts. "Running From Home" is a totally different song from "Strollin' Down the Highway," both of which are Jansch originals; AND it's the wrong song! (Number 13 is actually a cover of the blues song, "Key to the Highway.") Still, The River Sessions, though as far from Prog as one can get, is essential listening for fans of this legendary musician.
items._genre: acoustic folk / singer-songwriter / British folk
items._cn_summary: 这是1974年Bert Jansch在格拉斯哥的独奏原声吉他现场录音，没有乐队伴奏，仅由他一人与吉他完成。曲目多选自其个人专辑《L.A. Turnaround》，去掉了原录音中的脚踏钢棒吉他后，听众可以更清晰地感受他复杂的指弹技法与有力的和弦扫弦。演出中穿插了Pentangle时期的作品、自传性质的歌曲以及一首圣诞颂歌改编。Jansch在曲间与观众互动，展现出自信松弛的状态。录音音质出色，但曲目编排和演奏风格属于传统民谣范畴，未见明显的实验性或跨界融合元素。
