items.body: Review by alainPP — Deep Purple releases a stunning 24th album."Arrogant Boy" features a classic Purple-esque sound, with Simon and Don guiding each other through a galloping melody; gone are the tracks of yesteryear?make way for a fun song featuring a Hammond organ that channels Jon Lord, Ian's tight drumming, and angelic vocals. It's high-energy vintage rock in the vein of "Highway Star," telling the tale of an angry Billy. "Diablo" brings a groovy, retro vibe with swirling, mischievous energy. A symphony of organ and guitar ensues, with Keith Urban treating us to a country-blues solo reminiscent of ZZ Top. "The Rider" feels a bit repetitive, with Simon strumming in a melodic heavy-blues style. "The Lunatic" is driven by the organ; its sophisticated, airy usage is surprising, shifting into heavy prog during the solo. "The Only Horse in Town" opens with a velvety, proggy keyboard part; it's a jaunty tune where Simon channels a guitar hero, transporting us back to the 80s. "Sacred Land" keeps the listener hooked, starting with a disarming, atmospheric prog intro. Thirty seconds of pure bliss are followed by a Zeppelin-esque riff, with a Scottish air adding to the journey."The Beating of Wings" offers a melting blues moment reminiscent of the band's heyday, complete with a nostalgic-style solo."Guilt Trippin'" is the radio-friendly track?4 minutes and 52 seconds of piano arpeggios and martial snare drums exploding into an incandescent scorcher. It depicts a dialogue between God and Darwin about where things went wrong on Earth; Ian delivers a unique, snarling vocal performance, narrating the story before giving way to two solos?one of which is a breathtaking honky-tonk piano piece. "Scriblin' Gib'rish" is classic hard rock: heavy, with sparkling keyboards and a blazing guitar riff. "Jessica's Bra" offers a spirited, moving, and fresh track, complete with a bluesy solo featuring heavy organ and frenetic piano. "Third Call" showcases organ work in the vein of Lord and Airey?you wish it would go on forever?featuring an apoplectic, exhilarating organ solo. "My New Movie" is a straightforward, flowing tune featuring a solo by Simon over Roger's bass and a keyboard break that makes you sit up and take notice; it's like a sonata?simply divine. "Splat!" reminds me of an 80s track; it serves as a finale for an eclectic electric keyboard solo?reminiscent of Stevie Wonder?with a distant echo of ZZ Top. It's a track that brings you back to life?a breathless 50-minute ride.Deep Purple stands as a prime example of rock's enduring longevity. Simon is the driving force; he forges an identity that doesn't merely imitate his predecessors, riding alongside Don?a knight-errant amplifying his musical excursions. The 70s may be gone, but this album is redolent of the memories we'll always carry with us.
items._genre: classic rock / hard rock / proto-prog
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑延续了Deep Purple标志性的经典摇滚血脉，以 Hammond风琴、吉他riff和密集鼓点构建骨架，曲目多采用复古蓝调摇滚结构，融入少量前卫摇滚元素。制作侧重旋律驱动的叙事性歌曲，编排扎实但保守，缺乏对声音边界的大胆探索。乐评反复提及对乐队辉煌年代的致敬，关键词如'80年代风格''Zeppelin式riff''Honky-tonk钢琴'均指向传统摇滚语汇的复用。整体定位偏向怀旧型主流硬摇滚，与用户偏好的实验性、前卫融合路线存在明显距离。

items.body:
ENHYPEN have brought their THE SIN series to a cinematic close.

On 12 September, the K-pop group unveiled the music video for 'Checkmate', a B-side from their eighth mini album, THE SIN : BLISS. Released as a special gift for ENGENEs, the visual sees the members breaking free from their confines against the track's driving industrial beats and fast-paced techno rhythm.

The release concludes the narrative that began with THE SIN : VANISH and continued with THE SIN : BLISS. Built around the motif of “sin”, the series connects its music, lyrics, and multilingual narration as part of the group's larger storytelling.

THE SIN : BLISS also marked a new career high for ENHYPEN, earning the group their first number one on the Billboard 200. According to BELIFT LAB, the record sold over 2.09 million copies worldwide in its first week, becoming their fifth double million-selling album.

ENHYPEN will next take their ENHYPEN WORLD TOUR ‘BLOOD SAGA’ to Macau this October, followed by a four-dome tour across Japan from December through February and shows in Europe.

items.body: Light percussion opens “Down Home”, the new single from Melbourne instrumental funk quartet Karate Boogaloo, before a bass line takes the lead at an easy mid-tempo. The drums lock into a hard, tight pocket on a kit that sounds close to falling apart, while organ and choppy guitar come in over the top. That rattling kit gives the rough edge to a tune named after anything simple and worn in. The main theme leans openly on nostalgia, and the band reckon anyone who has declared the riff dead should “check their specs“. Drummer Hudson Whitlock plays alongside Henry Jenkins on bass, Callum Riley on organ and Darvid Thor on guitar. The four met as classmates at a Melbourne high school and have played together for almost two decades. In our July interview with the band, Jenkins explained that Karate Boogaloo began strictly as a covers act devoted to The Meters and Booker T. & The MG’s. The change came with an original called “Stay Healthy”, which he described as the moment the band “crossed the River Rubicon“. “Down Home” precedes Access All Areas, due on 9 October through Colemine Records and College of Knowledge Records. In February 2027 Karate Boogaloo tour the UK, France and the Netherlands. The run opens on 3 February aboard V11, a 1951 British lightship docked in Rotterdam, and closes upstairs at Paradiso in Amsterdam on the 13th. The London date is at the Jazz Cafe on 5 February. Further nights follow at Hyde Park Book Club in Leeds, The Abbey in Manchester, The Jam Jar in Bristol, Le Tetris in Le Havre and POPUP! in Paris. Stream “Down Home” and order Access All Areas HERE   The post Daily Discovery: Karate Boogaloo – Down Home appeared first on Rhythm Passport.

items._cn_summary: 墨尔本器乐放克四重奏Karate Boogaloo发布单曲《Down Home》，由Colemine Records与College of Knowledge Records联合发行。作品以轻盈打击乐开场，贝斯在中速节奏下主导行进，鼓组紧密咬合于硬派律动中，叠加管风琴与切分吉他。整体音色呈现粗糙质感，呼应歌名所暗示的朴素与年代感。该团体的四位成员自中学时代相识，合作近二十年，起初专注于翻奏The Meters与Booker T. & The MG's等经典放克曲目，后以原创曲目《Stay Healthy》转向独立创作。这首单曲收录于即将于十月发行的专辑《Access All Areas》之前。作为一首风格内敛的器乐放克作品，其音乐语言扎根于上世纪六十至七十年代的美国放克传统，以怀旧主旋律与扎实编排为核心，缺少显著的实验性扩展或跨类型融合意识，在声音探索层面趋于保守。

items.body: Stockholm post-punk trio Then Comes Silence released the single “Remaker Redeemer” on September 11, 2026, on Metropolis Records. It is the second track lifted from “Requiem Ballroom”, the band’s eighth studio album, due November 20, 2026. ‘Remaker Redeemer’: a song about starting over The band describes “Remaker Redeemer” as being about new life, saying the song “is about new life, being reborn with old sins washed away. A kind of cleansing, a fresh start, and the feeling of beginning again. The choice of instruments and sounds on this track was also a way to explore something a bit different this time.” The accompanying video was directed by Damon Zurawski of Future Legends Films, who also directed the video for “Judgement Day”, the album’s first single, released in early August. ‘Requiem Ballroom’: a diptych album “Requiem Ballroom” is structured as a diptych of two contrasting halves: “Requiem”, representing darkness, and “Ballroom”, representing light. “Remaker Redeemer” opens the “Ballroom” half of the record. The full album is available for pre-order on Bandcamp ahead of its November 20 release. Requiem Ballroom by Then Comes Silence “Requiem Ballroom” follows 2024’s “Trickery”, the band’s seventh album. The full tracklist for “Requiem Ballroom” runs: “Lay”, “Dance On The Edge Of The Grave”, “Bye Bye Land”, “Judgement Day”, “Lacrimosa”, “Hear The Silence”, “Remaker Redeemer”, “Witches And Demons”, “Delete Me”, “No Stranger”, “Black Magic Children” and “The Future Has A Silver Lining”. Then Comes Silence performed at M’era Luna Festival in Hildesheim, Germany in early August and are continuing an extensive European tour through the autumn, with dates including Rotterdam, Liège, Rennes, Paris, Lyon, Marseille, Torino and Prague. Tour details are available on the band’s website. About Then Comes Silence Then Comes Silence is a post-punk and gothic rock trio from Stockholm, founded by vocalist and bassist Alex Svenson in 2012. The current line-up, in place since 2022, features Svenson on vocals, bass and synthesisers, Jonas Fransson on drums, and Hugo Zombie on guitars. The band released three independent albums before signing to Nuclear Blast for “Blood” (2017), later joining Metropolis Records for “Machine” (2020), “Hunger” (2022) and “Trickery” (2024). Then Comes Silence have shared stages with Fields Of The Nephilim, Clan of Xymox, The Chameleons and A Place To Bury Strangers, and have performed at M’era Luna, Wave-Gotik-Treffen, Amphi Festival, Castle Party, Tomorrow’s Ghosts Festival and W-Festival. “Requiem Ballroom”, the band’s eighth album, follows “Remaker Redeemer” and “Judgement Day” and is set for release on November 20, 2026.
